/docs/practice-problems/grouped-query-at.title: Practice: Grouped Query Attention (GQA) From Scratch

/docs/practice-problems/int8-quantizatio.title: Practice: INT8 Weight Quantization From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/int8-quantizatio.description: Implement symmetric INT8 quantization and dequantization from scratch with NumPy -- the core compression trick behind serving LLMs cheaply.

/docs/practice-problems/k-nearest-neighb.title: Practice: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Classifier

/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-assignmen.title: Practice: K-Means, One Assignment Step
/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-assignmen.description: Implement K-Means' assignment step from scratch: assign each point to its nearest centroid by squared Euclidean distance, ties to the lowest index.

/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-update-st.title: Practice: K-Means, Centroid Update Step
/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-update-st.description: Implement K-Means' centroid update step in a real sandbox -- the genuine edge case a naive average-the-points solution misses: a cluster with zero points.

/docs/practice-problems/largest-rectangl.title: Practice: Largest Rectangle in a Skyline
/docs/practice-problems/largest-rectangl.description: Implement largest_rectangle_area(heights) in real O(n) using a monotonic stack -- not the O(n^2) brute-force check of every left/right bound pair.

/docs/practice-problems/layer-normalizat.title: Practice: Layer Normalization From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/layer-normalizat.description: Implement Layer Normalization from scratch with NumPy for a 2D batch -- the batch-size-independent normalization that's the default in Transformers.

/docs/practice-problems/level-order-trav.title: Practice: Level-Order Traversal (BFS)
/docs/practice-problems/level-order-trav.description: BFS on a binary tree in a real Python sandbox -- visit every node top-to-bottom, left-to-right, exactly the order BFS naturally produces from the root.

/docs/practice-problems/returns-to-go.title: Practice: Full Return-to-Go Sequence
/docs/practice-problems/returns-to-go.description: Compute the full return-to-go sequence for an RL trajectory in O(n) time using the backward recursive identity, instead of re-summing from scratch each step.

/docs/practice-problems/right-side-view.title: Practice: Right Side View of a Binary Tree
/docs/practice-problems/right-side-view.description: Level-aware BFS in a real Python sandbox -- find the rightmost visible node at every depth of a binary tree, not just a flat level-ordered list.

/docs/practice-problems/rms-normalizatio.title: Practice: RMS Normalization From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/rms-normalizatio.description: Implement RMSNorm from scratch with NumPy -- the simplified, cheaper LayerNorm variant that's the default normalization in most modern LLMs (LLaMA and successors).

/docs/practice-problems/rotary-positiona.title: Practice: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/rotary-positiona.description: Implement Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) from scratch with NumPy -- the dominant modern way to inject position information into attention.

/docs/practice-problems/rotting-oranges.title: Practice: Rotting Oranges (Multi-Source BFS)
/docs/practice-problems/rotting-oranges.description: Multi-source BFS in a real Python sandbox -- seed the queue with every rotten cell at once to correctly model rot spreading in parallel across a grid.

/docs/practice-problems/sample-mean-vari.title: Practice: Sample Mean and Variance From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/sample-mean-vari.description: Implement sample_mean_and_variance(data) from scratch -- the population mean and variance every summary statistic on this site builds on.

/docs/practice-problems/search-rotated-a.title: Practice: Search in a Rotated Sorted Array
/docs/practice-problems/search-rotated-a.description: Binary search a rotated sorted array directly for a target value in a real Python sandbox -- O(log n), without first finding the rotation point separately.

/docs/practice-problems/selu-activation.title: Practice: SELU (Scaled Exponential Linear Unit)
/docs/practice-problems/selu-activation.description: Implement the self-normalizing SELU activation function with exact scale (lambda) and alpha constants.

/docs/practice-problems/shortest-path-bf.title: Practice: Shortest Path in an Unweighted Graph
/docs/practice-problems/shortest-path-bf.description: BFS on a general graph in a real Python sandbox -- why exploring level by level guarantees the first path found to any node is the shortest one.

/docs/practice-problems/sigmoid-activati.title: Practice: Sigmoid Activation From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/sigmoid-activati.description: Implement the sigmoid activation from scratch using math.exp -- the same function behind Logistic Regression's output and binary classifier heads.

/docs/practice-problems/sigmoid-derivati.title: Practice: Sigmoid Derivative (Vectorized, Numerically Stable)
/docs/practice-problems/sigmoid-derivati.description: Implement sigmoid_derivative(z_list) that never OverflowErrors even at z=+/-1000 -- the vectorized, numerically-stable version, not the naive formula.

/docs/practice-problems/smallest-range-k.title: Practice: Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists
/docs/practice-problems/smallest-range-k.description: K-way merge with a twist in a real Python sandbox -- find the smallest range covering at least one element from every one of k sorted lists.

/docs/practice-problems/softmax-gradient.title: Practice: Softmax Gradient (Vector-Jacobian Product)
/docs/practice-problems/softmax-gradient.description: Implement the softmax vector-Jacobian product for backprop -- an O(n) identity that avoids ever materializing softmax's full n x n Jacobian matrix.

/docs/practice-problems/softmax.title: Practice: Numerically Stable Softmax From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/softmax.description: Implement a numerically stable softmax from scratch -- the standard multi-class output layer, and why the naive formula overflows on large inputs.

/docs/practice-problems/speculative-deco.title: Practice: Speculative Decoding Verification Step From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/speculative-deco.description: Implement speculative decoding's per-token accept/reject verification step from scratch with NumPy -- the modified rejection sampling that guarantees an exact match to the target model's own distribution.

/docs/practice-problems/standardize-data.title: Practice: Standardize a Dataset (Z-Score Normalization)
/docs/practice-problems/standardize-data.description: Implement z-score normalization from scratch in a real Python sandbox -- the standard feature-scaling step before gradient descent or any distance-based method.

/docs/practice-problems/swiglu-mlp.title: Practice: SwiGLU MLP Block From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/swiglu-mlp.description: Implement the SwiGLU feedforward block from scratch with NumPy -- the gated MLP used in LLaMA, Mistral, and Gemma's transformer blocks.

/docs/practice-problems/swish-activation.title: Practice: Swish Activation Function
/docs/practice-problems/swish-activation.description: Implement the Swish activation function f(x) = x * sigmoid(beta * x).

/docs/practice-problems/tf-idf-weight.title: Practice: TF-IDF Weight From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/tf-idf-weight.description: Implement TF-IDF from scratch -- term frequency times inverse document frequency, the classic fix for raw word counts overweighting common, low-meaning words.

/docs/practice-problems/three-sum-zero.title: Practice: Three Sum to Zero
/docs/practice-problems/three-sum-zero.description: Find every unique triplet summing to zero in a real Python sandbox -- two pointers run once per anchor element, with duplicate triplets actively suppressed.

/docs/practice-problems/top-p-sampling.title: Practice: Top-p (Nucleus) Sampling From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/top-p-sampling.description: Implement top-p (nucleus) filtering from scratch with NumPy -- the adaptive alternative to fixed top-k that most production LLM APIs expose.

/docs/practice-problems/two-lone-numbers.title: Practice: The Two Lone Numbers
